environment.description: Node.js 20 Express application deployed on a standard EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023) behind an ALB with default security group allowing inbound on port 3000. No network segmentation between application tier and monitoring endpoints. Container runtime uses default Docker profile with no syscall filtering. Application runs as root user in container.

config.network: ALB -> EC2 port 3000, no path-based routing restrictions
config.container_security: default Docker seccomp profile (allows all common syscalls)
